question: Which drugs in Table 1 use lipid-based nanocarriers, according to the text?

trace.query: SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND col_no IN (1,2,5) ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT p.page, p.text FROM lines p WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%lipid%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%liposom%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%LNP%' ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT line_no, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=3 AND line_no BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND (text LIKE '%lipid%' OR text LIKE '%Atu%' OR text LIKE '%EphA2%' OR text LIKE '%LNPs%' OR text LIKE '%DOPC%' OR text LIKE '%TKM%' OR text LIKE '%DCR%' OR text LIKE '%NBF%' OR text LIKE '%liposom%' OR text LIKE '%Overall%' OR text LIKE '%five%' OR text LIKE '%encompassing%' OR text LIKE '%exhibits%') ORDER BY line_no
SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE page=3 AND kind='line' AND (text LIKE '%Atu027%' OR text LIKE '%all five utilize%' OR text LIKE '%encompassing%')
